verses.text: Our LORD, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.

footnotes.text: winged creatures: See the note at 80.1.

verses.text: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.

footnotes.text: You … King: One possible meaning for the difficult Hebrew text.

verses.text: Our LORD and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our LORD, answered their prayers.
You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
Our LORD and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
We praise you, LORD God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
